verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security token: FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP card, PIV and encrypted storage, with open-source firmware and a local CLI. It is not a hosted data-processing or AI service, so an opt-out from AI model training is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey collecting user data for AI training or offering any related control that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
